text.description: Display width 1..4; at most 32 UTF-8 bytes; no controls, whitespace, zero-width or format/default-ignorable scalars

rewindFiles.description: Claude agents (capability claude-rewind-files): also restore files from Claude Code's file checkpoint of the first removed turn. Codex agents refuse true (rewind_files_unsupported); they use cutex/session/files/revert.

structuralOperationWarning.description: A problem after a committed history operation (fork / revert). Do not repeat the operation; e.g. claude_runtime_restart_failed: start the runtime explicitly.

sessionHistoryRevertResult.description: Codex (native thread/revert, thread/rollback) keeps its runtime: runtimeRestarted is false, no runtimeState / warnings. Claude (claude/thread/revert) restarts an online runtime: runtimeRestarted is the actual outcome, runtimeState the adapter runtime state afterwards, backupPath null when no native transcript existed. DSH (dsh/thread/revert) behaves like Claude (an online runtime is restarted); it reverts the conversation only: workspace files are never restored (DSH keeps no file checkpoints, rewindFiles is refused), native.result.filesRestored is false.

fromCutexSessionId.description: The sender's cutex session id when it is an agent on this host (local delegate, same-host tell); never another host's session

imageDelivery.description: Native acceptance mode for this image input, not proof the model has inspected it. Absent for queued, unconfirmed or receipt-less deduplicated input.

imageInputSettingsPatch.description: imageInput group in PATCH /v2/settings; an empty object is a no-op.

imageInputSteeringCapability.description: native.schema.capabilities.features.imageInputSteering; additive, preserves the existing imageInput boolean.

planChanged.description: source native: the observed account plan (nativeQuota.planType) differs from the previous snapshot; the profile's planLabel may have changed (re-read /v2/profiles).

claudeAccount.description: source claude: the Claude account the reading belongs to (one event per Claude profile bound to it).

usersChanged.description: Capability peer-owner-profile: a user's displayName / avatar changed without an owner action (reason peerProfile: pulled from paired peer peerId). Re-read GET /v2/users.
